# Fundamentals of Social Psychology — agent entry point

Canonical repository: https://github.com/caseykvanier/social_psych
Course: Fundamentals of Social Psychology, Vanier College, Autumn 2026

Start with:
- AGENTS.md for evidence, privacy, and answer rules.
- course.yml for the machine-readable course and chapter map.
- chapters/*/notes.md for the canonical slide-by-slide lecture notes.
- chapters/*/sources.yml for coverage, provenance, and review status.
- practice/index.yml for active practice and tutoring materials. See practice/multiple-choice-agent-guide.md for MC generation rules and practice/multiple-choice-examples.md for three generated examples.
- textbook/book.yml and textbook/sections.yml for the assigned open textbook.

Source priority for course questions:
1. Lecture notes for what the instructor taught and emphasized.
2. Source manifests for whether and when material was covered.
3. Slides for exact visible content.
4. Textbook for supporting explanation and background.
5. Clearly labelled outside sources only when requested.

Practice materials guide formative tutoring style but are not evidence of lecture coverage or assessment content. Never infer that textbook or slide content was taught when a source manifest says it was skipped or not yet discussed. Raw recordings and transcripts are private and are not part of this repository.
